The final two courses (COU1600 and COU4852) provide a deep dive into machine learning concepts and apply machine learning operations to real-world problems, respectively.

| 10 | COU305 | Capstone and Practice Exam (AZ-500) | Coursera | Practical application of cloud computing and DevOps skills |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of cloud computing and DevOps concepts, from foundational knowledge to hands-on experience with cloud-native architecture. The path starts with introductory courses on cloud computing and DevOps, followed by specialized courses on PaaS, IaaS, and Google Cloud DevOps. The path then delves into cloud security and cloud applications, and finally, provides hands-on experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture. The path is structured to provide a gradual acquisition of skills, with a balance between theoretical knowledge and practical application. The learner will be able to see the relevance of cloud computing and DevOps concepts to their own projects or goals, and receive regular feedback on their progress.

learning_path:
**Learning Path Table**
| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5529 | International Humanitarian Law in Theory and Practice | Coursera | Foundational understanding of international humanitarian law |
| 2 | COU1244 | International Law In Action: Investigating and Prosecuting International Crimes | Coursera | Contextualization and real-world connections to international law and justice |
| 3 | COU890 | Children's Human Rights - An Interdisciplinary Introduction | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding children's human rights |
| 4 | COU1205 | Introduction to International Criminal Law | Coursera | Gradual complexity, building on prior knowledge of international law and justice |
| 5 | COU413 | International Law in Action: A Guide to the International Courts and Tribunals in The Hague | Coursera | Emphasis on critical thinking and analysis, understanding international courts and tribunals |
| 6 | COU3152 | Human Rights for Open Societies | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding human rights in open societies |
| 7 | COU5181 | Climate Change and Human Rights | Coursera | Contextualization and real-world connections, understanding human rights in the context of climate change |
| 8 | COU5028 | Violence Against Healthcare | Coursera | Emphasis on empathy and perspective-taking, understanding violence against healthcare |
| 9 | COU6411 | Global Diplomacy: the United Nations in the World | Coursera | Emphasis on critical thinking and analysis, understanding global diplomacy and the United Nations |
| 10 | COU5708 | Privacy in the Western World | Coursera | Gradual complexity, building on prior knowledge of human rights and international law |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path provides a comprehensive and structured approach to human rights and international humanitarian law. The path starts with a foundational understanding of international humanitarian law (COU5529) and gradually builds on this knowledge with courses that contextualize and connect theoretical concepts to real-world scenarios (COU1244, COU413). The path then emphasizes empathy and perspective-taking with courses on children's human rights (COU890), human rights in open societies (COU3152), and human rights in the context of climate change (COU5181). The path also encourages critical thinking and analysis with courses on international law and justice (COU1205), global diplomacy and the United Nations (COU6411), and the intersection of human rights and healthcare (COU5028).
